name: AndroidArena
description: AndroidArena is an environment and benchmark designed to evaluate large language model agents on complex tasks within a modern operating system, focusing on challenges such as vast action spaces, inter-application cooperation, and user constraint adherence.
reputation: A newer benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on Android tasks; it is relevant to the growing mobile-agent community but is not yet as established as older web/OS agent benchmarks.
notes: Includes scalable semi-automated benchmark construction and adaptive metrics for non-unique solutions; identifies key LLM agent weaknesses and proposes exploration strategy improvements.
